file_position_valid.name: file_position_valid
file_position_valid.value: ("kernel"."file"."latitude" is null) = ("kernel"."file"."longitude" is null) and coalesce("kernel"."file"."latitude" between -90 and 90, true) and coalesce("kernel"."file"."longitude" between -180 and 180, true)

node_junction_fields.name: node_junction_fields
node_junction_fields.value:
("gis"."node"."type" = 'junction' or ("gis"."node"."junction_type" is null and "gis"."node"."main_size_mm" is null and "gis"."node"."branch_size_mm" is null))
        and (("gis"."node"."junction_type" is null) = ("gis"."node"."main_size_mm" is null))
        and ("gis"."node"."main_size_mm" is null or "gis"."node"."main_size_mm" > 0)
        and ("gis"."node"."branch_size_mm" is null or ("gis"."node"."main_size_mm" is not null and "gis"."node"."branch_size_mm" < "gis"."node"."main_size_mm"))
        and ("gis"."node"."junction_type" is distinct from 'reducer' or "gis"."node"."branch_size_mm" is not null)

work_order_event_position_valid.name: work_order_event_position_valid
work_order_event_position_valid.value: ("work_orders"."work_order_event"."latitude" is null) = ("work_orders"."work_order_event"."longitude" is null) and coalesce("work_orders"."work_order_event"."latitude" between -90 and 90, true) and coalesce("work_orders"."work_order_event"."longitude" between -180 and 180, true)

account_suffix_needs_parent.name: account_suffix_needs_parent
account_suffix_needs_parent.value: "accounts"."account"."suffix_index" is null or ("accounts"."account"."parent_account_id" is not null and "accounts"."account"."suffix_index" >= 1)

customer_contact_placeholder_phone.name: customer_contact_placeholder_phone
customer_contact_placeholder_phone.value: not "accounts"."customer_contact"."is_placeholder" or ("accounts"."customer_contact"."channel" = 'phone' and "accounts"."customer_contact"."normalized" is null and not "accounts"."customer_contact"."is_primary")

invoice_type_terms_shape.name: invoice_type_terms_shape
invoice_type_terms_shape.value:
coalesce(("tariffs"."invoice_type"."terms_kind" = 'full' and "tariffs"."invoice_type"."min_deposit_bp" is null and "tariffs"."invoice_type"."min_deposit_amount" is null and "tariffs"."invoice_type"."installment_count" is null and "tariffs"."invoice_type"."installment_interval_days" is null)
        or ("tariffs"."invoice_type"."terms_kind" = 'minimum_deposit' and (("tariffs"."invoice_type"."min_deposit_bp" between 1 and 10000 and "tariffs"."invoice_type"."min_deposit_amount" is null) or ("tariffs"."invoice_type"."min_deposit_bp" is null and "tariffs"."invoice_type"."min_deposit_amount" > 0)) and "tariffs"."invoice_type"."installment_count" is null and "tariffs"."invoice_type"."installment_interval_days" is null)
        or ("tariffs"."invoice_type"."terms_kind" = 'installments' and "tariffs"."invoice_type"."min_deposit_bp" is null and "tariffs"."invoice_type"."min_deposit_amount" is null and "tariffs"."invoice_type"."installment_count" between 2 and 60 and "tariffs"."invoice_type"."installment_interval_days" between 1 and 365), false)

late_fee_rule_rate_xor_flat.name: late_fee_rule_rate_xor_flat
late_fee_rule_rate_xor_flat.value: coalesce(("tariffs"."late_fee_rule"."rate_bp" between 1 and 10000 and "tariffs"."late_fee_rule"."flat_amount" is null) or ("tariffs"."late_fee_rule"."rate_bp" is null and "tariffs"."late_fee_rule"."flat_amount" > 0), false)

tariff_version_line_band.name: tariff_version_line_band
tariff_version_line_band.value: "tariffs"."tariff_version_line"."from_units" is null or ("tariffs"."tariff_version_line"."from_units" >= 0 and ("tariffs"."tariff_version_line"."to_units" is null or "tariffs"."tariff_version_line"."to_units" > "tariffs"."tariff_version_line"."from_units"))

tariff_version_line_bounds.name: tariff_version_line_bounds
tariff_version_line_bounds.value: "tariffs"."tariff_version_line"."to_units" is null or "tariffs"."tariff_version_line"."from_units" is not null
